page.overview:
Who is Mazurka?

Mazurka is a major character in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius debuting in Season Three as an antagonist and member of the Hollow Keepers.

Mazurka is a fair-skinned young woman with long reddish brown hair and red eyes. She wears a white blouse with semi-transparent sleeves, black shorts, white tights, and silver heels. For combat she wields a black spear bladed in both tips, adorned with red jewels.

Mazurka is aggressive and resentful at first. After suffering harassment from her peers due to her popularity, she became more isolated. When her village lost the ability to feel emotion, she was thrilled, as she would no longer be targeted. Ever since she believes that emotions are unnecessary since negative ones can prove destructive. She stomps her feet whenever she is irritated and becomes gradually nicer towards Fina and befriends her alongside Daisy.

Mazurka's Trust Master reward is the Adept Double-Edged Spear passive special ability which increases ice, water, earth and light resistance (20%) and increases physical and magic damage against plants (50%).
